name: v3.0.23
body:
## Bug fixes
- fix: adjusted CPU stress tests on CPUs with super cores and hide unavailable core options (#3691)
- fix: fixed CPU temperature averaging by excluding out-of-range sensor readings (#3692)
- fix: fixed overlapping controls in StepperInput with a unit picker (#3687)

## New features
- feat: added persistent reader history with minute aggregation and 24-hour retention
- feat: added an option to animate Icon widget (#3705)
- feat: added Battery module to the Remote
- feat: rebuilt lldb with Snappy compression to reduce history storage
- feat: added text widget to the Battery module (#3685)

name: v3.0.22
body:
## Bug fixes
- fix: fixed authorization polling, device IDs and keychain access in the Remote installer (#3693, #3694, #3695)
- fix: fixed oversized host_statistics64 count in RAM on older macOS versions (#3688)
- fix: another try to fix feft-aligned sensors view in the Combined modules (#3652)
- fix: fixed battery stats not updating when plugged in and fully charged (#3615)
- fix: fixed external APFS disk I/O showing zero by resolving the actual storage driver (#3679)
- fix: simplified issue templates
- fix: fixed chart axes shifting when new values are added

## New features
- feat: added a top process to all previews (#3480)
- feat: added issue templates
- feat: redesigned the line chart tooltip design and positioning

## Localization
- lang: updated slovenian translations (#3683)

name: v3.0.21
body:
## Bug fixes
- fix: fixed incorrect Ethernet link speed on 10GbE adapters (#3510)
- fix: fixed the Wi-Fi location permission prompt by adding the missing Location entitlement (#3675)
- fix: fixed the Network popup briefly showing the interface as down during details refresh
- fix: fixed the SMC helper authorization bypass when signing certificates are empty
- fix: fixed SMC helper shutdown races and waited for fan restoration before uninstalling or reinstalling the helper
- fix: fixed Remote popup refresh when fetching account order fails (#3666)
- fix: adjusted Battery temperature reading on macOS 27 for some SoC (#3648)
- fix: fixed stale Bluetooth device entries after removal or charging connection changes (#3591)

## New features
- feat: added a new Icon widget that allows to show module icon in the menu bar (#3646)
- feat: added new m6 SoC support (#3668)

## Localization
- lang: added translations for the Icon widget

name: v3.0.20
body:
## Bug fixes
- fix: fixed the Sensors alignment in combined modules (#3652)
- fix: stopped querying Wi-Fi SSID and BSSID without Location permission

## New features
- feat: added new workflow to build, sign, notarize and publish releases (not active for now)
- feat: added new sensor mappings for MacPro5,1 (#3647)
- feat: added an option to show only the Stats icon in the menu bar and open the combined popup (#3622)
- feat: improved SMC caching and fan control reliability
- feat: added caching for HID sensor discovery

## Localization
- lang: removed unused string
- lang: added translations for the new Wi-Fi location permission strings
